title: The Last Car
summary: The man in red reads rule four and walks into the last car despite June's pleas. The lights die; you keep your eyes shut and hear a ticket punch click in the dark. When the lights return, his seat is empty and his phone rings. You notice every newspaper is dated nineteen eighty seven. Then your own phone rings with Mom calling, and a voice whispers your name. Rule five tells you it isn't her. The train slows as the voice waits on the line.

end_card.title: PART 3
end_card.hook: Whose handwriting is on the rules?

continuity_out: Time remains 2:14 AM on Night 1. You hold the rules sheet and your ticket with one hole. The man in red is gone; his phone rings on the empty seat. Every newspaper shows the date 1987. Your phone rang with a voice that whispered your name and said to come home. The conductor's punch clicked in the dark but your ticket still has only one hole. June is terrified and gripping your sleeve. The train is slowing for the next stop. You have not fallen asleep again.
